# starts

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:starts`](gmeow-starts.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/starts>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen STARTS: this event and the related event begin together, and this one ends first (it is an initial sub-span). NOT transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:startedBy`](gmeow-startedBy.md). (= [time:intervalStarts](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalStarts); TimeML BEGINS; TEO starts.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when two events begin together and this one ends first — an opening act that starts a festival (the Allen STARTS link, an initial sub-span).

### Avoid when

- Avoid confusing it with mereological [`gmeow:subEventOf`](gmeow-subEventOf.md) (this is a temporal extent relation, not part-of) and avoid expecting transitive closure; starts is non-transitive.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:starts`](gmeow-starts.md) between the co-beginning [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) occurrences and read [`gmeow:startedBy`](gmeow-startedBy.md) as its inverse.

### Examples

- ex:openingAct [`gmeow:starts`](gmeow-starts.md) ex:festival.
